description: Check the Personal Agent Protocol file you published: Last Price fetches https://<domain>/.well-known/poppy.json and compares it with the one get_agent_protocol gives. A match verifies the domain for your workspace; a failure returns reason and message saying what to fix, and a domain another workspace verified answers 409. Answers 404 until agent protocol files are switched on for your workspace. Needs a Last Price credential with routing write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.
name: verify_agent_protocol
